gizmo.title: Tambaya ta lamba
gizmo.description: Tambayar da ake amsawa da lamba. Amsar lamba ce tsayayye ko dabarar da aka lissafa daga masu canji, kuma ana ƙirga ta idan tana cikin iyakar haƙuri.

configure.title: Tambaya
configure.description: Abin da ake tambayar masu koyo. Rubuta sunan mai canji a cikin baka mai lanƙwasa, kamar {d}, don nuna ƙimarsa.

configure.title: Ma'auni
configure.description: Ana nuna shi a matsayin rubutu kusa da filin amsa, misali km/h.

configure.title: Amsa
configure.description: Lamba daidai. Bar shi babu komai idan dabara ce ke lissafa amsar.

configure.title: Dabara
configure.description: Yana lissafa amsar daga masu canji, misali d / (t / 60). Za a iya amfani da + - * / ^, baka, sqrt() da abs(). Ana amfani da shi maimakon amsar idan an saita.

configure.title: Masu canji
configure.description: Lambobin da dabarar da tambayar ke amfani da su. Kowanne yana ɗaukar ƙima tsakanin mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girmansa, a matakai.

advanced.title: Haƙuri
advanced.description: Nisan da ke daga ainihin amsa wanda har yanzu ake ƙirga shi. 0 yana nufin daidai, ko an zagaye zuwa wuraren da ke ƙasa bayan ɗigo.

advanced.title: Nau'in haƙuri
advanced.description: Cikakke: ƙari ko ragi na haƙurin. Kashi: ƙari ko ragi na wannan kashi na ainihin amsa.

advanced.title: Wurare bayan ɗigo
advanced.description: Ana tambayar masu koyo su zagaye zuwa wurare nawa, kuma ana nuna amsar an zagaye ta haka. Bar shi babu komai don rashin zagayawa.

advanced.title: Ƙoƙari
advanced.description: Sau nawa mai koyo zai iya dubawa. 0 yana nufin mara iyaka.

advanced.title: Sababbin lambobi a kowane gwaji
advanced.description: Kawo sababbin ƙimomin masu canji duk lokacin da mai koyo ya sake gwadawa. Sannan ba a nuna amsarsu ta baya idan sun dawo, sai dai ko sun yi daidai.

advanced.title: Ana iya naɗewa
advanced.description: Nuna wannan tambaya a matsayin layi da ke buɗewa da rufewa. Buɗe ɗaya yana rufe sauran tambayoyin da ake iya naɗewa da ke kusa da shi.

advanced.title: Fara a naɗe
advanced.description: Idan ana iya naɗewa, fara a matsayin layi a rufe da ke nuna tambayar da matsayinta kawai.

developer.title: Sunan tambayoyin
developer.description: Sunan tambayoyin da ake amfani da shi don gano xAPI a tsarin nazari.
